title: Immutable custom-container preparation
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Prepare an immutable container; detect startup assumptions and unsupported automatic swap.

sourceContract.readme: **App Service, custom containers:** Validate immutable image deployment and initialization; native auto-swap is unsupported for Web App for Containers.
sourceContract.backlogDeliver: Add an App Service custom-container preset with immutable images and explicit initialization/swap controls.
sourceContract.backlogAcceptance: Container startup and native swap behavior are observed; unsupported auto-swap is not offered as a working option.
sourceContract.portableCard: Prepare an immutable container; detect startup assumptions and unsupported automatic swap.
sourceContract.nativeSibling: Conduct one custom-container slot preset; verify actual image, initialization, and native swap outcomes.
sourceContract.nativePrerequisites: D-S123: P001 and D-S026, plus BASE = H011 + P005 + HOST. B-S123: CORE, DATA, C063, C064.
sourceContract.qualification: This A lesson checks synthetic behavior only; it does not satisfy native or source-parent acceptance.

preconditions: All container, image, digest, registry, startup, readiness, platform, promotion and journey fields are fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY.
The fictional registry uses example.invalid; digests and image names identify no actual artifact.
Preparation requires a digest reference and observed fictional pull success.
Initialization requires port agreement, completed initialization, required dependencies, explicit acceptable status and meaningful readiness.
Shared plan capacity is 10 fictional units; active production uses 6 and a normal candidate uses 3. Extra slots add no capacity.
Two started candidate journeys each use an original 500 ms budget and exactly one effect; unknowns remain attempted.
actions: Select a fixed fixture and controlled manual or pipeline path
Demonstrate unsupported native auto-swap rejection without exposure
Observe complete started candidate journeys and retained failure/unknown history
Reset only in-memory DATA and restore keyboard focus
assertions: Preparation is not readiness, and initialization gates precede any promotion.
Mutable images, failed pulls, wrong ports, failed or unknown startup, shallow green readiness and insufficient shared headroom cannot promote.
Native auto-swap is unsupported; no working native-auto-swap choice exists.
Former-production recycling and in-flight interruption are explicit modeled observations, not native evidence.
Identity, session, state, destination, exactly-once effects and the original latency budget determine each synthetic journey outcome.
Negative and unknown started journeys remain in the denominator; empty samples and old-production success are not migration proof.
Commands have strict exact typed shapes; complete state and history are replay validated, immutable and bounded to 20 accepted actions.
Keyboard, actionable error, reset and actual browser CSP checks pass.
Normal verification is read-only; only exact CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 deliberately captures new browser evidence.

limits: No actual container, image, digest verification, registry, startup, readiness, resource, configuration, promotion, journey or Azure observation.
No Docker build/pull, registry operation, native automatic swap, IaC, scaffold, identity, credentials, deployment, packages, frameworks, downloads or expenditure.
No five-nines, production Node.js 24, native B-S123 or source-parent D-S123 validation.
The published helper's known unattended lifecycle limitation remains; this bounded observation does not qualify the inactive prototype or general local harness.
One original S unit only; testing, repair, proof and refinement earn zero additional credits.
C005-C008 and local-harness catalog integration remain parent-owned.
Parent-owned empirical acceptance is required; the worker cannot award Done.
